answer_1.quote: QE is an area of research concerned with the development of models for the prediction of the quality of machine-generated translations when gold standard translations are not available.

answer_2.quote: In QE, the best practice is to use Pearson's r to measure performance.

answer_4.quote: Each sentence pair was judged on a scale from 0-100 by at least 3 evaluators.
answer_4.guideline: inadequate (i.e. non-meaning preserving) translations should not receive a score higher than 70, even if only one word is incorrect.
